reasons: Detention quantity (5.5 hrs) exceeds allowable chargeable time (2 hrs) based on dock in/out timestamps.
Detention amount billed ($412.5) is higher than contract-supported amount ($150).
decision.dispute_summary: Detention billed for 5.5 hours at $75/hr ($412.50) exceeds the contract free time of 2 hours and the actual detention of 2 hours (4h dock time minus 2h free). Correct detention charge should be $150.00.
